source_quality_scale.4: official primary source or official catalogue; current legal duty, reporting route, operational method, service definition or safety control verified
source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material dynamic-state, suspected-report, self-declaration, case-specific, jurisdiction or scope caveat

quality_guards: Pesticide product and active-substance authorisations are dynamic and require a current database check.
Pesticide incident routing depends on the affected subject and enforcing premises.
Drinking-water complaints and notified events apply to the identified supply and time period.
Pollution reports are allegations for review and do not by themselves establish a breach or responsible party.
Yellow Card reports describe suspected events and do not alone prove product causality.
Field Safety Notices and Drug Safety Updates are product- and time-specific and require current checking.
Port compliance declarations are duty-holder submissions rather than live independent inspection results.
Event and crowd controls depend on venue, audience, activity and current operating conditions.
UKHSA plans describe response frameworks and do not prove live local capacity for a specific event.
Animal-welfare reports and inspections are case-specific and triaged by urgency and evidence.
Official-source context is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Live parity, browser acceptance, publisher push and remote readback remain required.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
